data.title: U.S. Property Development Announces Grand Opening of Hamburg, New York Self-Storage Facility Managed by CubeSmart
data.description: A private real estate investment company, U.S. Property Development, centered on industrial, self-storage, and commercial real estate, unveiled the opening of its new self-storage facility in Hamburg, New York. The grand opening marks a significant milestone for the company's expansion efforts. Located in Hamburg, the facility offers storage solutions for individuals and businesses looking for secure and convenient storage options. This development signifies the company's commitment to diversifying its portfolio and meeting the growing demand for self-storage facilities in the area.

data.description: Swisslog Healthcare, a prominent provider of pharmacy and transport automation solutions, has collaborated with PharmaSystems in Canada to distribute the Tenutō Cold Chain portfolio. data.title: Carolina Panthers and Bank of America Launch 3rd & Goal
data.description: A prominent community platform aimed at aiding students in the Carolinas is set to engage 10,000 young individuals in its inaugural year. The initiative concentrates on enhancing literacy skills, promoting physical wellness, and fostering personal well-being. Over 400 students from Title I schools marked the commencement of this program with an exclusive field day gathering held at Bank of America Stadium.

data.title: COOLER WEATHER DOESN'T MEAN FLEAS AND TICKS ARE GONE: TEVRA PET URGES PET PARENTS TO KEEP PROTECTION GOING THIS FALL
data.description: The "Protect Their Everywhere" campaign by Tevra Pet serves as a reminder to families that despite the beauty of fall adventures, there is still a risk of encountering pests. Launched in Omaha, Neb., on September 15, 2026, the campaign highlights the various activities families engage in during the fall season. Whether it's crisp morning walks, weekend hikes, backyard football games, or cozy afternoons at home, the risk of exposure to unwanted pests remains constant. These activities can expose pets and families to pests such as fleas and ticks, which can pose health risks. Keeping this in mind, Tevra Pet stresses the importance of preventative measures to safeguard the well-being of pets and family members.

data.title: General Mills Named to 3BL’s 2026 100 Best Corporate Citizens List for 18th Consecutive Year
data.description: General Mills of Minneapolis has been recognized on 3BL's 2026 100 Best Corporate Citizens list, securing the No. 5 spot in the Consumer Staples category for an impressive 18th consecutive year. The company showed significant improvement in various areas, with notable progress seen in Environment, Stakeholders and Society, Human Rights, and Governance. They made strides by expanding regenerative agriculture practices to over 800,000 acres and cutting greenhouse gas emissions throughout their value chain.
